# Choose Chicago

> > The official destination marketing organization for Chicago, providing comprehensive guides to neighborhoods, attractions, dining, culture, and events across the city.

Choose Chicago serves as the primary tourism resource for visitors planning trips to Chicago, offering curated guides to the city's diverse neighborhoods, iconic landmarks like the Chicago Riverwalk and Magnificent Mile, cultural attractions, dining scenes, and year-round events. The site features extensive coverage of Chicago's architecture, LGBTQ+ community, ethnic heritage districts, and accessibility resources.

## Key Topics

- Chicago neighborhoods
- Chicago Riverwalk
- Lake Michigan beaches
- Chicago Architecture Center
- Chicago Cultural Center
- Magnificent Mile
- Neighborhood tours
- Chicago dining scene
- Cultural tourism
- LGBTQ+ Chicago
- Historic landmarks
- Free attractions
- Bronzeville
- Hyde Park
- Lincoln Park

## Neighborhood & Cultural Guides

- [Ultimate LGBTQ+ Neighborhood Guide to Chicago](https://www.choosechicago.com/articles/lgbtq-plus/the-ultimate-lgbtq-chicago-guide): LGBTQ+ guide to Northalsted/Boystown, Andersonville & Legacy Walk
- [A guide to Puerto Rican culture in Chicago's Humboldt Park](https://www.choosechicago.com/blog/neighborhoods-blog/puerto-rican-culture-humboldt-park): Puerto Rican culture tour of Humboldt Park with Paseo Boricua highlights
- [Polish Heritage in Chicago | Neighborhood Guide](https://www.choosechicago.com/articles/itineraries/polish-heritage-chicago-neighborhood-guide): Polish heritage guide to Division, Milwaukee & Ashland Avenue neighborhoods
- [Foodie's Guide to Chicago's Little Italy Eats](https://www.choosechicago.com/blog/dining/a-foodies-guide-to-chicagos-little-italy-neighborhood): Little Italy dining guide on Taylor Street with Italian restaurants & bakeries

## Top Attractions & Activities

- [Chicago in the Summer: What to Do When the City Shines](https://www.choosechicago.com/articles/bucket-list/summer-guide-to-chicago): Summer guide to Chicago beaches, Lake Michigan, festivals & outdoor activities
- [10 Must-Do Things on the Chicago Riverwalk Today](https://www.choosechicago.com/blog/arts-culture-entertainment/10-things-you-should-absolutely-do-on-the-chicago-riverwalk): Chicago Riverwalk activities: dining, kayaking, boat tours & architecture
- [Free Things to Do in Chicago All Year Round Long](https://www.choosechicago.com/articles/tours-and-attractions/free-chicago-museums-attractions): Budget guide to free Chicago museums, Cultural Center & year-round attractions
- [Accessibility in Chicago: Favorite Spots to Explore](https://www.choosechicago.com/blog/arts-culture-entertainment/accessibility-in-chicago-a-local-shares-favorite-spots-for-blind-and-visually-impaired-visitors): Accessibility guide for blind/visually impaired visitors by Beth Finke

## Architecture & History

- [Chicago's Art Deco Architecture | Downtown Icons Guide](https://www.choosechicago.com/blog/architecture-history/a-guide-to-chicagos-art-deco-architecture): Art Deco architecture guide featuring Carbide & Carbon Building & landmarks
- [Explore the Chicago Architecture Center South Loop](https://www.choosechicago.com/blog/architecture-history/explore-the-fascinating-architecture-around-chicagos-south-loop): South Loop architecture tour featuring Motor Row & Prairie Avenue mansions

## Dining & Food Tours

- [Chicago Food Tours | Guided Eats & Local Favorites](https://www.choosechicago.com/articles/food-drink/chicago-food-tours): Guided food tours featuring Bobby's Bike Hike, Underground Donut Tours & more
- [Women-owned & Minority-Owned Chicago Restaurant Week](https://www.choosechicago.com/blog/dining/neighborhood-favorites-chicago-restaurant-week): Chicago Restaurant Week guide to women-owned & minority-owned restaurants
- [Guide to restaurants in Chicago's new Time Out Market](https://www.choosechicago.com/blog/inside-time-out-market-chicago): Time Out Market Chicago food hall guide in West Loop's Fulton Market

## Entertainment & Nightlife

- [Where to see live music, comedy, and more in Chicago](https://www.choosechicago.com/blog/music/live-music-concerts-chicago): Live music & comedy venue guide featuring The Bassment, The Promontory & more
- [Kit Kat Lounge & Supper Club](https://www.choosechicago.com/blog/nightlife/kit-kat-lounge-supper-club-2): Kit Kat Lounge LGBTQ+ supper club with drag shows in Lakeview

## Event Planning & Special Occasions

- [Chicago Bachelor Party | Event & Vacation Planning Resources](https://www.choosechicago.com/blog/nightlife/chicago-bachelor-party-8-ways-to-celebrate-in-the-city): Bachelor party planning guide featuring Wrigley Field, boat tours & nightlife
- [6 ideas for planning a family reunion in Chicago](https://www.choosechicago.com/blog/special-events/family-reunion-in-chicago): Family reunion planning with African-American heritage sites & soul food tours
- [10+ films to catch during the Chicago International Film Festival 2025](https://www.choosechicago.com/blog/special-events/chicago-international-film-festival): Chicago International Film Festival 2025 film guide & screening highlights

## Optional

- [Mother's Day in Chicago: Your guide to gifts, dining, and events](https://www.choosechicago.com/blog/special-events/mothers-day-chicago): Mother's Day dining & gift guide with Beatrix, Virtue Restaurant & more
